name: Junior Staff in Training
org: City of Tucson Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Build leadership skills and prepare for future work in recreation. Participants may work up to 30 hours per week.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 17. Teens and parents must attend an orientation. Space is limited.
pay_detail: Registration fee $25 for City residents, $30 for non-residents. The page does not say participants are paid. A discount program exists for low-income families.
duration: Up to 30 hours per week. Program dates not listed.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Call Class Registration at 520-791-4877 or use the Register for Classes link on the page. Orientation details are emailed after you sign up. A Discount Program is there for people who need low income help.
notes: Aims at recreation careers. Contact 520-791-4873 for the schedule.
